# Load Data


# **Data preparation**

## Load & Align Metadata

```{r}

# count_mat (geny x probki)
gene_ids <- rat$Geneid
count_mat <- as.matrix(rat[, -(1:6)])
rownames(count_mat) <- gene_ids

count_samples <- basename(colnames(count_mat))
count_samples <- sub("_ratNor7_Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam$", "", count_samples)
colnames(count_mat) <- count_samples

metadata <- fread("/home/aleks/Desktop/Rat-Homo pipeline/neoteny_cocultures_metadata.csv")

# metadata only for samples present in counts (safe NA handling)
metadata_sub <- metadata[!is.na(sample_id) & sample_id %in% count_samples]

# order metadata exactly like count_samples (cleaned)
metadata_sub <- metadata_sub[match(count_samples, metadata_sub$sample_id), ]

# hard check
stopifnot(all(metadata_sub$sample_id == count_samples))

# build coldata for DESeq2
coldata <- as.data.frame(metadata_sub)
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sample_id

```

## Prepare-count-matrix

## Clean Sample Names

```{r}
clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- basename(x)
  x <- sub("_ratNor7_Aligned\\.sortedByCoord\\.out\\.bam$", "", x)
  x <- sub("_Aligned\\.sortedByCoord\\.out\\.bam$", "", x)
  x <- sub("_ratNor7$", "", x)
  x
}

colnames(count_mat) <- clean_sample_id(colnames(count_mat))

cn <- colnames(count_mat)


count_samples <- cn

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(cn))

# опционально -посмотреть первые 3
cn[1:3]

```

## Parse Species Labels

```{r}


# 1) Rat neurons only: RatNor_pn-Neurn, но НЕ coculture/cocultures
is_rat_neurons_only <-
  grepl("RatNor_pn-Neurn", cn) &
  !grepl("cocultur", cn) &                 # ловит coculture и cocultures
  !grepl("HomSap|PanTro|MacMul", cn)       # на всякий случай

# 2) Rat neurons + Human astro: HomSap_i-Astro + coculture/cocultures
# (НЕ требуем "Neurons", потому что у части HomSap-сэмплов его нет: OPprep/IFprep и т.п.)
is_rat_neurons_human_astro <-
  grepl("HomSap_i-Astro", cn) &
  grepl("cocultur", cn)

keep <- is_rat_neurons_only | is_rat_neurons_human_astro

count_mat_sub <- count_mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]

group_sub <- ifelse(is_rat_neurons_only[keep],
                    "RatNeuronsOnly",
                    "RatNeuronsPlusHumanAstro")
group_sub <- factor(group_sub,
                    levels = c("RatNeuronsOnly", "RatNeuronsPlusHumanAstro"))

table(group_sub)

# (опционально) посмотреть, что именно выбралось
cn[is_rat_neurons_only]
cn[is_rat_neurons_human_astro]





keep_by_name <- is_rat_neurons_only | is_rat_neurons_human_astro
samples_by_name <- cn[keep_by_name]




```

## Subset Rat/Human Samples

```{r}

# metadata фильтр (Rat/Human, без NA) + пересечение с выбором по имени
keep_meta <- !is.na(coldata$species) & coldata$species %in% c("Rat", "Human")
samples_meta <- rownames(coldata)[keep_meta]

samples_to_use <- intersect(samples_meta, samples_by_name)

# --- MINIMAL FIX 1: ensure order matches count matrix columns ---
samples_to_use <- samples_to_use[samples_to_use %in% colnames(count_mat)]
samples_to_use <- colnames(count_mat)[colnames(count_mat) %in% samples_to_use]

count_mat_sub <- count_mat[, samples_to_use, drop = FALSE]
coldata_sub   <- coldata[samples_to_use, , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_mat_sub), rownames(coldata_sub)))

# --- MINIMAL FIX 2: add clear English group factor (from your name-based grouping) ---
group_lookup <- data.frame(
  sample_id = samples_by_name,
  group_raw = as.character(group_sub),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

coldata_sub$neuron_group <- group_lookup$group_raw[match(rownames(coldata_sub), group_lookup$sample_id)]
stopifnot(!any(is.na(coldata_sub$neuron_group)))

coldata_sub$neuron_group <- factor(
  coldata_sub$neuron_group,
  levels = c("RatNeuronsOnly", "RatNeuronsPlusHumanAstro"),
  labels = c("Rat_neurons_only", "Rat_neurons_plus_human_astro")
)

table(coldata_sub$neuron_group)

```

# DESeq2

```{r}
# Use the experimental factor you defined (not species)
coldata_sub$neuron_group <- relevel(factor(coldata_sub$neuron_group),
                                   ref = "Rat_neurons_only")

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(count_mat_sub),   # counts should be integers
  colData   = coldata_sub,
  design    = ~ neuron_group
)

dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds,
               contrast = c("neuron_group",
                            "Rat_neurons_plus_human_astro",
                            "Rat_neurons_only"))


```

## Shrink LFC and Summarize

```{r}
res_shrunk <- lfcShrink(
  dds,
  contrast = c("neuron_group",
               "Rat_neurons_plus_human_astro",
               "Rat_neurons_only"),
  type = "ashr"
)

res_df <- as.data.frame(res_shrunk)
res_df$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(res_df)

head(res_df[order(res_df$padj), ], 20)
summary(res_df)

sum(res_df$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(res_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 1, na.rm = TRUE)



```

## Annotate Genes

```{r}
# Annotate genes (Rat annotation stays the same)
gene_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Rn.eg.db,
  keys = unique(sub("\\..*$", "", res_df$ensembl_gene_id)),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = c("ENSEMBL", "SYMBOL", "GENENAME")
) %>%
  distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  rename(ensembl_gene_id = ENSEMBL)


```

```{r}
#| label: merge-annotations
gene_map_df <- as.data.frame(gene_map)

# очистка версий
gene_map_df$ensembl_clean <- sub("\\..*$", "", gene_map_df$ensembl_gene_id)

res_df$ensembl_clean <- sub("\\..*$", "", res_df$ensembl_gene_id)

# merge БЕЗ dplyr::select
res_annot <- merge(
  res_df,
  gene_map_df[, c("ensembl_clean", "SYMBOL", "GENENAME")],
  by = "ensembl_clean",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# удобная метка
res_annot$label <- ifelse(
  !is.na(res_annot$SYMBOL) & res_annot$SYMBOL != "",
  res_annot$SYMBOL,
  res_annot$ensembl_clean
)


```

# Visualizations

## Volcano-plot

```{r}
#| label: volcano-pick-genes
# thresholds
padj_thr <- 0.05
lfc_thr  <- 1

# classify points
res_annot <- res_annot %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      !is.na(padj) & padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange >=  lfc_thr ~ "Up",
      !is.na(padj) & padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange <= -lfc_thr ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    neglog10_padj = -log10(padj)
  )

# choose genes to label: top by padj among significant
top_up <- res_annot %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1) %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

top_down <- res_annot %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1) %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 7)

label_df <- rbind(top_up, top_down)


```

```{r}
#| label: volcano-plot
#| fig.height: 6
#| fig.width: 8

vol_pal <- c(NS = "grey70", Up = "darkblue", Down = "black")

ggplot(res_annot, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neglog10_padj)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), alpha = 0.7, size = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = vol_pal) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_thr), linetype = "dashed") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = label),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano plot (lfcShrink, Rat neurons ± human astro exposure)",
    x = "log2FoldChange (Rat_neurons_plus_human_astro / Rat_neurons_only)",
    y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
    color = "DE class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()



```

```{r}
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
pca_data <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "neuron_group", returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"), 1)
pca_data$name <- rownames(pca_data)
```

## PCA

```{r}
#| label: pca-plot-clean
#| fig.height: 6
#| fig.width: 8

ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = neuron_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_group) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  labs(color = "Group") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: pca-sample-table-clean
pca_table <- pca_data %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Sample = name,
    Group  = neuron_group,
    PC1    = round(PC1, 2),
    PC2    = round(PC2, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Group, PC1)

pca_table




```
